jei.simplemoney.links: Additional trades for loaded mods. Default: enabled. Buy only, one item, 8-64 bills; no discounts. Default: 8 linked purchases per player per 24000 game ticks, 100 ticks between purchases. Original trades remain. See Simple Money wiki: linked price tables.
simplemoney.guide.page.1.title: Simple Money
simplemoney.guide.page.1: Currency production, weighted villager trades and treasure loot.
simplemoney.guide.page.2.title: Special Paper
simplemoney.guide.page.2: Crafted from two paper and one honeycomb; used with an iron ingot and resin fiber to smith a banknote blank.
simplemoney.guide.page.3.title: Special Fiber
simplemoney.guide.page.3: Crafted from copper nuggets, gold nuggets, amethyst shards, and diamonds; used with a gold ingot to refine a banknote blank.
simplemoney.guide.page.4.title: Resin Fiber
simplemoney.guide.page.4: Crafted from iron nuggets, resin clumps, honeycomb, and bone meal; used to smith banknote blanks.
simplemoney.guide.page.5.title: Banknote Blank
simplemoney.guide.page.5: An uncommon smithing ingredient made from special paper, resin fiber, and an iron ingot. Refine it with special fiber and a gold ingot.
simplemoney.guide.page.6.title: Refined Banknote Blank
simplemoney.guide.page.6: An uncommon ingredient made by refining a banknote blank. Three blanks, green dye, and ink sacs produce three raw bills.
simplemoney.guide.page.7.title: Raw Bill
simplemoney.guide.page.7: A rare crafting result. Blast it for 24,000 ticks (one in-game day in a vanilla blast furnace; SimpleBuilding
simplemoney.guide.page.8.title: Raw Bill
simplemoney.guide.page.8: blast furnaces are 2, 4 or 8 times faster) to produce one money bill and 20 experience points.
simplemoney.guide.page.9.title: Money Bill
simplemoney.guide.page.9: Currency for the added villager and wandering trader offers. Epic, fire resistant, and always glinting; using it plays a page-turn sound and emits a happy-villager particle without consuming it.
simplemoney.guide.page.10.title: Treasure currency
simplemoney.guide.page.11.title: Server configuration
simplemoney.guide.page.11: config/simplemoney.json preserves trades.enableVillagerTrades and trades.enableWanderingTrades, both true by default.
simplemoney.guide.page.12.title: Paper rocket recipe
simplemoney.guide.page.12: Additional source recipe: seven paper and two gunpowder produce one rocket.
simplemoney.guide.page.13.title: Money Links: Add-on Trades
simplemoney.guide.page.13: Adds buy-only money offers for loaded mods without removing their original trades. Default: enabled.
